events.verdict: Sengun (HOU) brings his hands towards Marshall (DAL) as he releases away, and the contact during the pick is marginal.
Durant (HOU) brings his forearm slightly forward as he jumps alongside Flagg's (DAL) path as he defends the driving shot attempt. The contact that occurs to Flagg's front is marginal.
Gafford (DAL) defends the drive and makes marginal contact to Sengun's (HOU) body, while he gets to the height of the ball and blocks the shot attempt with his other hand.
Marshall (DAL) makes marginal contact with Thompson's (HOU) arm while contesting the shot attempt.
Gafford (DAL) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Sengun (HOU).
Smith Jr. (HOU) extends his leg out and makes intentional foot to ball contact.
Thompson (HOU) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Flagg's (DAL) arm.
Gafford (DAL) briefly grasps and releases Sengun' (HOU) arm as they navigate the pick. This contact is marginal.
Gafford (DAL) is in the paint for at or about three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Sengun (HOU) and Christie (DAL) come together as Sengun attempts his shot attempt near the rim, and the hand to hand contact between Sengun and Christie is marginal.

Thompson (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position during Flagg's (DAL) drive, moving along his path toward the rim with a legal bent arm to his side, and Durant (HOU) jumps vertically to defend his shot attempt.
Marshall (DAL) releases the throw-in before 5 seconds elapses.
After the initial contact during the screen, Gafford (DAL) and Okogie (HOU) briefly stay attached as they navigate the screen. This contact is marginal.
Durant (HOU) brushes Gafford's (DAL) arm as he pursues the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
